name: Don Quixote
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Don Quixote was written by Miguel de Cervantes, first published in 1605.
An aging man convinces himself he is a knight-errant and sets off on delusional adventures -- often called the first modern novel.
Discussion prompt: Idealism vs. Reality is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
